result_text: I HTML-escaped the repository names in both tooltips, so a name like `acme "shop"` is now treated as text. I only compiled the `reports` module; I didn't run any tests or generate a report to check the hover text. Both changes are in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (in `reports/.../landscape/statichtml/`), using `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4`, which `DataExporter` already uses: - **Language blocks:** the name is escaped in `addLangInfo`, which builds the "N repositories: name (X LOC)" tooltip. - **Size table:** the name is escaped in the per-category tooltip text, "name LOC". Counts, LOC, order and layout are unchanged. I also added the `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils` import.
